name: Omashare
author: lcd1232
description: Mirror your screen and its audio to an Apple TV over AirPlay, from the Omarchy bar. Prototype.

barWidget.description: Find AirPlay receivers, pair with a PIN the first time, and mirror a screen, window or region with sound.

schema.label: What to share
schema.description: picker: choose a screen, window or region in the screen-share dialog each time. monitor: share the focused monitor without asking.

schema.label: Maximum stream resolution
schema.description: The screen is scaled down to fit, keeping its aspect ratio.

schema.label: Screen audio
schema.description: tv: sound plays only on the receiver (local output is muted while sharing). both: also keep playing locally. off: video only.

schema.label: Notify when sharing starts and stops
